verses.author: model_A
verses.text: A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Someone left the porch light burning anyway --

a small yellow argument

against whatever leaves.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Phone still lit on the nightstand,
someone's thumb hovering --
not to send, just to feel
the weight of almost.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Kettle screams and nobody moves --

we've learned to let some things

finish alone.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
The dog waits by the door

long after the leash has been put away,

still certain someone is coming back for it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Frost on the window melts

in the shape of a hand

that isn't touching it.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Porch light left burning

into the second morning --

not for anyone now, just habit

finding a switch to hold onto.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The calendar still open

to a month we've already left --

nobody's turned the page, nobody wants to be the one.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Steam still rising

from a cup no one claimed --

someone will drink it cold, just to say it wasn't wasted.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The dog waits by the door

at the old time, for the old car --

we let him, it costs nothing to be wrong together.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Someone laughs in the next room --

we lean toward the sound like plants toward light,

not knowing yet what was funny, just glad for it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The porch light left on all night --

not for anyone coming back,

just so the dark has one less place to win.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Snow filling in yesterday's footprints --

no one says the path is gone,

we just walk a little closer together now.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The kettle clicks off by itself --

no one was waiting on it,

but the whole kitchen relaxes anyway.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A dog turns three circles before lying down --

no memory of wolves, just the shape

of a habit older than the house itself.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The stray cat won't come closer than the fence --

not distrust exactly, just the distance

it has decided love requires.
